answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks through peer-witnessed optical challenges. When outdoor agents meet, staked peers send a nonce that a target displays by shifting charged pigment capsules in an exterior electrophoretic panel. Witnesses log 3D pose coordinates against the horizon alongside the pattern to bind each identity to one chassis, forcing attackers to build and power separate hardware per node. However, dust or spray driven by a gale can foul lenses and block verification.
